localDispatchNote: Three of the four local scripts re-took cleanly on sourceSha256 b924a27a…. The dispatch script does not, twice: a Chromium extension force-installed on this machine — /usr/share/chromium/extensions/cimiefiiaegbelhefglklhhakcgmhkai.json, whose whole content is an external_update_url — is installed into the harness's fresh profile and injects a page-script into the http:// origin, and the check that nothing left the expected origin counts it. The page's own requests and its connect-src 'none' are unchanged, and the same nineteen checks passed 19/19 against the https:// live URL at 19:06:44Z on this build. The 12:54:49Z run was therefore left in place as the local record rather than replaced by a run that fails for a reason this package does not control, and local-dispatch-retake-2026-09-03.json is the disclosure of that choice. Suppressing the extension would mean adding a browser flag in scripts/, which would move sourceSha256 away from the published tree; the source is frozen instead.

limitations: No model has chosen a tool here. Every dispatch in every run was written by a script that already knew the tool name, the arguments and the revision to quote. Both hosted reports say so in their own notClaimed text. A bridge and five host configs now exist for a model to attach through, and no model has attached.

A hosted browser check is delivery proof, not user proof. Nobody outside the author has used this page. GATE-P2 is the instrument waiting for that, and it is a gate this package set itself rather than one the hackathon's rules ask for. simulated-panel-2026-09-03.json is a formative review by scripted reviewers, classified INFERENCE; it is not a user study, not learner validation, and not evidence of adoption.

The local dispatch record binds the source tree as it stood before scripts/ grew, and one re-take of it fails on this machine for a third-party reason. Both facts are in localDispatchNote and in local-dispatch-retake-2026-09-03.json rather than smoothed away.

The injection result is bounded. The page quarantines the one fixture answer that carries an instruction, and the quarantine is a rule about that fixture's shape, not a general defence against prompt injection.
Contrast figures are arithmetic on composed colours and the accessibility tree is what a screen reader would be handed; neither is a report of the page being read or heard.
No run has happened in ChatGPT's in-app browser, on macOS, iOS, Safari, or on a physical phone. The 420px column is measured headless.
No video exists, so nothing visual has been checked against this release by a person watching it.
E4 is not achieved and must not be claimed while model replay, GATE-P2 and the video are open.
